s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings tossed with 2 tsp baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter and serve with 150ml ranch.
Top 16 small blinis with 150g crème fraîche, 150g smoked salmon and snipped chives. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Bake 1kg chicken thighs at 200C for 25 minutes, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and bake 10 more. Make mac and cheese from 300g macaroni, 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml milk and 200g cheddar. Serve with 400g sautéed silverbeet.

w.note: getting ready for prison canteen food
w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 30g cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour over heat until thick. Pour into 4 cups, chill 2 hours and top with crushed chocolate biscuits.

d.how: Juice or blend 3 green apples, 1 cucumber, 3 celery sticks and a knob of ginger with 300ml water. Strain and serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
